about.title: About Me
about.body: I'm based in Vitória da Conquista, Bahia. With over 12 years of experience, I build end-to-end solutions — from embedded systems to mobile apps and web platforms. I combine business vision with engineering: I design the architecture, write the code and ship to production. I also founded my own technology company.
